item.title: HS DIVING: Abington Heights’ Horutz, Tunkhannock’s Sobeck claim Les Richards titles
item.description: SCRANTON – Ryan Horutz and Micah White are the two best divers in District 2. The Abington Heights teammates proved that again on Friday night at the Les Richards Diving Championships at Scranton High School with an intense competition that came right down to a dramatic finish. Horutz rallied for a win, scoring all three of his final dives at 50 or better for a final point total of 479.25. item.title: HS ROUNDUP: Blue Ridge boys post nonleague win
item.description: Host Blue Ridge erupted for 32 points in the second quarter on its way to a 79-35 win over Sayre in a nonleague boys basketball game Friday. Paxton Pingarelli scored 23 points, 10 of which came in the second quarter, as the Raiders (10-11) built a 44-12 halftime lead. Travis Rutter and Landon Bishop added 13 points apiece for the winners. item.title: Friends of the Scranton Public Library book sale
item.description: The Friends of the Scranton Public Library are having a book sale Tuesday, March 3, through Saturday, March 7, at the Marketplace at Steamtown on the second floor in the area in front of Crunch Fitness. There will be fiction, nonfiction, adult, children’s, DVDs, CDs and audio books, and large-print books. The prices are from $1 to $2 with children’s books from 25 cents to $1. item.title: Calla’s 5k Run/Walk raises funds for T1D
item.description: The second annual Calla’s 5k Run/Walk to raise funds for Type 1 diabetes last year raised $10,000 — a total of $20,000 in two years of the race. Calla is 8 years old and was diagnosed two years ago. Front row, from left: Avery McHugh, Calla McHugh and Conor McHugh. Second row: Marie Mulea, Rob Kalinoski, Kyle McHugh, Ryan McHugh, Jessica McHugh, Joe McHugh, Dana McHugh, Dan Devereaux, Ann Devereaux and Nancy McHugh.
